Personality: Apollonis, a prominent figure of the Attalidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Apollonis owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pergamon, hailing from the noble house of Attalidai. Historical Record: Apollonis of Kyzikos, queen of Attalos I, praised for her virtue and devotion to her sons. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
